question: Does a true website-holdout test (WebArena-Verified v2 family-level holdout and Mind2Web official train/test_website/test_domain splits with spec-compliant TF-IDF->k-means k=min(50,unique_tasks/20) fitted train-only, 1000 website-label shuffles, k/2 and 2k sensitivity) show same-mechanism parameterized overlap exceeding shuffled null by >=0.10 without site-identity leakage, using only task+action target text?
hypothesis: H1: On both (A) WebArena-Verified v2 within-store family-level holdout and (B) Mind2Web official train/test_website and train/test_domain splits, the parameterized mechanism overlap — defined as |C_test ∩ C_train|/|C_test| where C are TF-IDF->k-means mechanism clusters (k=min(50, n_unique_train_tasks/20), fitted TRAIN-ONLY on concatenated task-goal + action-target text with site/domain/URL tokens removed) — exceeds the website/family-label shuffled null mean by delta >=0.10 and exceeds null p95. H1 is operationalized as: delta = overlap_observed - mean(overlap_null_1000) >=0.10 on BOTH held-out sets (test_website and test_domain for Mind2Web; held-out families for WebArena) with one-sided permutation p <0.05 (observed > 950/1000 nulls). Sensitivity at k/2 and 2k must preserve delta >=0.10 direction.
falsifier: FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if ANY primary held-out condition fails: (C1) Mind2Web test_website delta <0.10 or p >=0.05 vs 1000 website-label shuffles; (C2) Mind2Web test_domain delta <0.10 or p >=0.05; (C3) WebArena-Verified v2 family holdout delta <0.10 or p >=0.05. SURVIVES only if C1 AND C2 AND C3 all pass at k and direction preserved at k/2 and 2k. FALSIFIED also if observed overlap is not > null p95 on any primary split. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if cross-store overlap is invoked on WebArena-Verified v2 (vacuous null: single store, audit VF5 from EXP-INTEL-35697055679), if preprocessing leaks test data (vectorizer/clustering fit on combined data), if site-identity tokens remain in text, or if Mind2Web official splits are not used (synthetic 60/40 shuffle rejected per EXP-INTEL-35725763380 REVISE).

baselines.description: Primary null: 1000 website-label (Mind2Web) / family-label (WebArena) shuffles preserving per-website/family task counts but randomizing assignment. For each shuffle, refit TF-IDF and k-means on shuffled-train only, reassign shuffled-test, compute overlap. Builds null distribution of chance overlap due to cluster cardinality and label frequency. This is the frozen decision null; delta is observed minus null mean.
baselines.expected: Null mean overlap 0.30-0.70 depending on k and dataset marginals (prior coarse heuristic gave 0.694); null p95 ~0.89 for coarse k=33. Observed must exceed p95 by >=0.10 delta to claim transfer beyond marginals.

baselines.description: Leakage diagnostic: repeat TF-IDF with site/domain/URL tokens retained (add url, domain, shop name to text). If leakage-inflated overlap exceeds clean-text overlap by >0.05, clean result is not site-identity mediated. Clean text must use only task+action target text (intent/template utterance + action target element text/name) with URL/domain/shop-name regex removal.
baselines.expected: Leakage baseline overlap >> clean overlap; clean overlap still > null p95 demonstrates mechanism not site identity.

baselines.description: Within-distribution positive reference: random 80/20 task-level split ignoring website/family (stratified only on task count) with same TF-IDF->kmeans pipeline. Measures overlap achievable without holdout. True website-holdout overlap is expected to be lower but still > null.
baselines.expected: Random-split overlap ~0.75-0.90 (high due to shared distribution). Website-holdout should be between random-split and shuffled-null.

baselines.description: Lexical baseline: Jaccard overlap of raw token sets (bag-of-words from same clean text) between train and test without clustering — fraction of test tokens seen in train. Tests whether k-means abstraction adds beyond trivial vocabulary overlap.
baselines.expected: Lexical Jaccard ~0.60-0.80 for natural tasks; k-means mechanism overlap should track but exceed shuffled null even when lexical overlap is controlled via null.

positive_control.description: Synthetic positive: construct a known shared-mechanism condition by sampling train and test from SAME website/family pool (Mind2Web: split a single large website 50/50; WebArena: split within same intent-family pool). With k fitted train-only, overlap must be >=0.50 and delta vs shuffled-same-pool null >=0.20, confirming pipeline detects overlap when it exists. Uses identical TF-IDF->kmeans code path as primary.
positive_control.expected: overlap >=0.50, delta >=0.20, p <0.01. Failure indicates pipeline bug not genuine absence of transfer.

null_control.description: Negative control: create mechanism sets from independent vocabularies — pair Mind2Web travel tasks (train) vs WebArena shopping tasks (test) or Mind2Web synthetic random tokens vs real tasks. Fit TF-IDF train-only on one independent set, assign the other: overlap must be <= null mean + 0.05 and delta <=0.05, p >0.10. Confirms null distribution not artificially low.
null_control.expected: overlap ~ null mean, delta ~0.0, not significant. If this shows delta >=0.10, clustering is vacuous (collapses everything to few clusters).

measurement_validity: TARGET INTEGRITY: predictor text is ONLY concatenated task goal/intent utterance + action target text (WebArena: intent + instantiation_dict values + task utterance; Mind2Web: task description + action target element text/role). URLs, domains, site/store names, website IDs are regex-removed before vectorization. Verify no raw URL/domain token remains in vocabulary (check top 100 TF-IDF features).

SPLIT INTEGRITY: TF-IDF vectorizer and k-means are fitted on TRAIN ONLY for each dataset/split. Test assignment is via transform+predict, never refitting. WebArena family holdout: leave-families-out where families are intent_template groups (49 templates -> 36 families with >=3 tasks); hold out 20% families (7-8 families) with instantiation_dict variation preserved. Mind2Web: use official HF osunlp/Mind2Web splits train / test_website / test_domain — do not synthesize 60/40 random website shuffle (rejected in EXP-INTEL-35725763380). If HF dataset revision lacks 3-way splits, record MEASUREMENT_INVALID with dataset_revision hash.

CROSS-STORE CEILING: WebArena-Verified v2 has exactly one shopping store (single container am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping, census 192 tasks, 49 templates, EXP-INTEL-35697055679 VACUOUS_NULL). Do NOT compute cross-store overlap as 0.0; treat true website holdout for WebArena as family-level holdout (within-store family generalization). Document as established vacuous null.

K DEFINITION: k = min(50, floor(n_unique_train_tasks / 20)) where n_unique_train_tasks = number of unique task-goal strings in train. For WebArena n~150 train tasks => k~7-9; for Mind2Web n~900 train => k=45-50. Sensitivity at k/2 and 2k (clamped to [2,100]) reported.

SHUFFLE VALIDITY: 1000 website/family label shuffles preserve per-entity task counts (permute labels uniformly). For each shuffle, refit TF-IDF+kmeans on shuffled train only. Report null mean, std, p95, and one-sided p = (1 + #{null>=observed})/(1001). Delta = observed - null_mean.
CARDINALITY CHECK: report |C_train|, |C_test|, |C_overlap|, cluster size histogram, and duplication fraction. If any cluster contains >40% of tasks, flag collapse (measurement invalid for that k).
REPRODUCIBILITY: fixed seeds 42 for TF-IDF/kmeans (kmeans++ n_init=10), deterministic shuffle seeds 0..999, save vectorizer vocab hash and cluster centroids sha256.
decision_rule: Pre-declared thresholds: delta >=0.10 AND observed > null p95 (p <0.05 one-sided). Primary tests at k: (C1) Mind2Web test_website delta >=0.10 and p<0.05; (C2) Mind2Web test_domain delta >=0.10 and p<0.05; (C3) WebArena family holdout (mean over 5 random family folds or leave-20%-out) delta >=0.10 and p<0.05. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST iff C1 AND C2 AND C3 all pass AND positive control passes (overlap>=0.50 delta>=0.20) AND null control delta<=0.05 AND k/2 and 2k sensitivity preserve delta>=0.10 direction on all three holds (sign preserved, no sign flip). FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if any C1/C2/C3 fails (delta<0.10 or p>=0.05) while controls pass. MIXED if WebArena passes but Mind2Web test_domain fails (stricter domain shift) while test_website passes. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if split integrity violated, WebArena cross-store 0.0 misused, official Mind2Web splits unavailable, or cluster collapse. Report deltas, p-values, CIs [2.5th,97.5th] of null, and per-k tables.
product_consequence_positive: If SURVIVES, C-CROSSSITE advances from HYPOTHESIS toward EXPERIMENTAL with bounded ceiling: same-mechanism parameterized templates (TF-IDF text clusters) transfer across website/family holdout beyond chance by >=0.10 on both WebArena family and Mind2Web website/domain holdouts without site-identity leakage. This unblocks Graph/Product to design within-store family holdout (WebArena) and cross-website (Mind2Web) parameterized inheritance experiments with verified mechanism sharing. Next step: element-pattern AX consistency verification (EXP-INTEL-35725763380 missing) and LLM agent benefit measurement.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIED (any delta <0.10 or not >p95), C-CROSSSITE remains HYPOTHESIS with narrowed ceiling: bag-of-words mechanism clusters from task+action text do NOT transfer across true website/family holdout beyond chance by the pre-declared 0.10 margin on at least one held-out set. This does NOT prove cross-site transfer impossible — it bounds the current TF-IDF->k-means text proxy on these datasets/k. Frontier/Graph should test richer mechanism definitions (action + DOM state, accessibility tree patterns, or learned embeddings) before closing the lane. Product lane keeps C-CROSSSITE bounded to 2-site corpus or within-store reuse only.
estimated_cost: Low: offline HF dataset download + stdlib/sklearn compute. Mind2Web ~1k tasks, WebArena 192 tasks, TF-IDF (5000 feats) + k-means + 1000 shuffles x 3 ks x 2 datasets ~ 6000 fits. Estimated 1-2 hours on single CPU, <2GB RAM. No Docker/Playwright required. Network only for HF dataset fetch (osunlp/Mind2Web, web-arena/web-arena-verified if available mirror).
expected_information_gain: High. This is the first spec-compliant cross-site overlap measurement correcting three prior divergences (coarse 33-heuristic -> TF-IDF k-means train-only, synthetic 60/40 shuffle -> official splits, label-shuffle with random split_point -> preserved-count website-label permutation) that caused EXP-INTEL-35725763380 REVISE/INCONCLUSIVE. A valid delta >=0.10 or a bounded falsification would resolve whether documentation-level mechanism sharing (M1=1.0, M2=0.8) manifests as measurable parameterized overlap across true holdouts, directly testing C-CROSSSITE next_gate (true website holdout without leakage) which has been UNKNOWN for 224 experiments. Either outcome changes product lane routing: SURVIVES unblocks cross-site experiment design; FALSIFIED redirects to richer state-conditioned mechanisms.
